summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialised in __init__ and set/cleared in a try/finally inside run()'s run_app coroutine. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests covering not-running (before run and after run returns), same-thread, widget access, awaitable callable, timeout-style exception re-raise, variadic/keyword forwarding, and exit value from a background thread. All 9 pass on Python 3.9 when PYTHONPATH points at the repo's src; without that, the venv imports a shared base checkout that lacks the method. Existing async tests (e.g. tests/test_widget.py) fail in this venv because pytest-asyncio is not installed; unrelated and not fixed. Nothing committed.
